title: Tangential divergence in an orthonormal frame: trace(p_Q ∘ B) = Σ τ_a·Bτ_a (Simon Ch. 2, 4.20)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let τ_1, …, τ_n be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P whose span is the subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P. Let p_Q : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be the orthogonal projection onto Q, and let B : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map. Then trace(p_Q ∘ B) = Σ_{a=1}^n τ_a·Bτ_a.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ B.toLinearMap) = ∑ a, inner ℝ (τ a) (B (τ a))
